findings.title: check_rate_limit returns 429; design claims silent 200 drop for impression rate limit
findings.summary: FR-5.4 requires a silent 200 OK on rate-limit breach. The actual check_rate_limit decorator always returns 429 with an error body. These cannot both be satisfied simultaneously.

findings.title: Design contradicts itself on impression rate-limit response code (200 vs 429)
findings.location: Design §3, POST /api/track/impression error table vs FR-5.4
findings.summary: The error table says 429 from decorator; FR-5.4 and the narrative say 200 silent drop. The requirement is authoritative; using @check_rate_limit as written violates it.

findings.title: unique_reach recount double-counts newly added impression row due to SQLAlchemy auto-flush
findings.summary: The +1 adjustment assumes the new AdImpression row is not visible to the subsequent COUNT query, but SQLAlchemy auto-flushes before queries by default, so the row is already counted. unique_reach will be 1 too high on every new unique visitor.

findings.title: Campaign list endpoint causes N+1 queries via lazy-loaded advertisement/placement relationships
findings.location: Design §2, GET /api/advertiser/campaigns and campaign list serialiser note
findings.summary: Accessing campaign.advertisements[0].placement.name in a loop over N campaigns triggers 2N additional SQL queries. The design claims this is 'not an extra query' which is incorrect. Also risks IndexError if advertisements list is empty.

findings.title: advTrackClick uses event.preventDefault() which blocks fallback navigation if fetch fails
findings.summary: Calling event.preventDefault() on the anchor click suppresses the href fallback. If the tracking fetch fails or times out, the user's click navigates nowhere. Remove preventDefault; the href attribute provides sufficient fallback navigation.

findings.title: require_advertiser() return value usage for status checks is unspecified
findings.summary: The guard returns a session object but routes that check advertiser.status must access session.advertiser (lazy load). The design does not state this pattern explicitly, leaving the implementation ambiguous.

findings.title: placement_id from multipart/form-data is a string; integer conversion not shown
findings.summary: request.form values are always strings. The design does not show int() conversion of placement_id before the AdPlacement.query.get() call. Without it, the lookup silently fails and returns a misleading 400.

findings.title: loadTab loaders replacement snippet is not syntactically complete
findings.summary: The two-line replacement snippet lacks a closing semicolon and is split across lines in a way that could produce a syntax error if pasted verbatim. A complete, self-contained replacement should be shown.

findings.title: AdvertiserSession.token missing index=True, causing full table scans on every authenticated request
findings.summary: Every impression and click tracking request resolves the X-Advertiser-Token header via a full table scan. AdminSession and AccountSession in models.py both have index=True on their token columns; AdvertiserSession should too.

findings.title: CSV report day-iteration mechanism not specified; timedelta import not shown
findings.summary: The design states the loop runs (end_date - start_date).days + 1 times but does not show how to generate actual date values. The timedelta import needed for start_date + timedelta(days=i) is not listed in the new file's imports.

findings.title: Click URL validation checks '/admin' instead of FR-6.2's '/api/admin', blocking legitimate advertiser destinations
findings.summary: Checking '/admin' in url.lower() rejects URLs like https://college.ac.ke/administration. The requirement specifies '/api/admin' as the forbidden substring. The design is broader than specified.

findings.title: AdDailyStat has no index on campaign_id; stats endpoint query is a full table scan
findings.summary: The only constraint on AdDailyStat is a unique index on (advertisement_id, date). Queries filtering by campaign_id have no index support, causing full table scans as the table grows.

findings.title: No route creates AdPayment records; admin payments tab has nothing to display or confirm
findings.location: Design §4, revenue and payments routes; FR-4.6, FR-4.7
findings.summary: GET /api/admin/payments and PUT /api/admin/payments/<id>/confirm are defined, but no code path creates AdPayment rows. The design is silent on when and how payment records come into existence.

findings.title: Seed code indentation context not shown
findings.summary: The new placement seeding block must be inside the existing with app.app_context(): block. The design's snippet does not show its indentation context.

findings.title: escHtml on href is correct HTML practice; non-issue flagged for completeness
findings.summary: Using escHtml on link_url in href attributes is correct; HTML parsers decode & entities in attribute values. No change needed.
